result.summary: The page appears largely intact. One minor visual inconsistency was found: the delivery-time badge on the first 'Fastest near you' card is clipped/overlapping the card edge, unlike the badges on the other cards. Excluding the intentionally scrollable carousels and content cut off by the viewport bottom, no other defects are apparent.

issues.description: The '15-25 min' delivery-time badge on the Green Bowl Poké card overlaps the dish image and appears to be cut off or misaligned at the card's left edge, while the equivalent badges on neighboring cards render correctly.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the badge is positioned consistently within the card bounds with proper margins and that its label is fully visible.
